scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/server build:native && bun run build:workspace
scripts.format: prettier --write .github apps CONTRIBUTING.md README.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github apps CONTRIBUTING.md README.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:fast: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server build:native:test && bun run test && bun run test:browser
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run test:fast && bun run build:workspace
